setup_authorization.description: Send the complete value Setup <code> over verified HTTPS, not an OAuth Bearer token. Retrieve the host-generated code only through protected host/deployment management. Keep it transient; never put it in URLs, logs, cookies or browser storage. Required for every Join/retry and before completion for every Create/retry, admission check, retained intent lookup and cancel. Retired after verified completion. The header-free Create alternative is only an exact completed retry authenticated using the request's administrator/password, not unauthenticated setup.
setup_authorization.name: Authorization

info.description: Composition host for unified service deployment
info.title: unified-server

post.description: Check the host-local setup capability only. A successful check neither binds intent nor authorizes a later request; send Authorization on every setup mutation.

204.description: Setup capability currently valid; no body

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

post.description: Requires the setup capability and exact active nonsecret Create or Join intent (including discovered Join issuer, recoverable through /idp/setup/intent). Cancellation and entry into retirement serialize on the same active-operation lock: cancellation cannot acknowledge 204 after retirement starts (409 while the capability remains valid; retired capabilities deny). A 204 is not proof cleanup has finished; observe status. Disconnect alone never cancels accepted work.

204.description: Exact active cancellation token signaled; no body; cleanup may still be running

400.description: Invalid intent (empty body), or malformed/unreadable JSON (text/plain rejection)

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

409.description: No active cancellable work, mismatching intent or retirement already started

422.description: JSON does not match a Create or Join intent

post.description: Before completion, Authorization: Setup <code> is required for every request, including exact retries. Durable exact intent binding precedes 202 and owner mutation. Acceptance is not completion: poll /idp/setup/status. Request disconnect does not cancel host-owned work; use explicit cancel. After completion, only an exact retained retry authenticated through the normal password grant using the supplied administrator/password can return 200; no setup header or Bearer token is required for that retry.

200.description: Exact completed retry authenticated with normal password grant; ready:true

202.description: Durably admitted or already active exact Create; ready:false; observe completion through setup status

400.description: Invalid human intent/password (empty body), or malformed/unreadable JSON (text/plain rejection)

401.description: Setup capability or normal completed authentication denied

409.description: Conflicting retained/active intent, occupied command queue or cancellation before acceptance

503.description: Admission, coordinator or completed readiness/authentication unavailable; no body. Accepted provisioning failures are observed through status, not this response

post.description: Read the exact retained nonsecret unified Create or Join intent using the current setup capability. Join includes the authenticated peer and discovered issuer. No request body; does not resume mutation or authorize another request. Retired capabilities deny.

200.description: Validated canonical retained intent for this host's owner scope

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

503.description: Protected state unavailable or retained intent invalid; no body

post.description: Requires Authorization: Setup <code> on every request. Authenticates issuer discovery against the pinned peer before durable canonical Join admission and 202. No issuer or credentials are accepted from the caller. Accepted work belongs to the host, not the HTTP request; poll status and use authorized exact cancellation. Exact retries retain peer/issuer and identity, including complete-owner/unretired-admission finalization. Retired admission denies; normal User authorization remains separate on source approval routes.

202.description: Durably admitted or already active exact Join; joining is not readiness

400.description: Invalid nonce, Node name or canonical pinned peer

401.description: Missing, invalid or retired setup capability

503.description: Discovery, admission or coordinator unavailable; accepted owner failures appear in status

get.description: Public nonsecret setup observation, not mutation authority. Poll after 202. Completed status re-evaluates existing local owner readiness on every request; learned revocation or a failed check returns 503 with ready:false and no login Client. Normal protected APIs retain their independent authentication/authorization. No password, token or setup code is returned.

200.description: Current setup state; awaiting_choice, creating, joining and unfinished are not completion
